listing.name: Valkyrie Profile / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Upstream PlayStation setup package using your own matching disc and any required BIOS. Finish generation with upstream; that external copy keeps its own runtime updates and player data.

steps.title: Finish the upstream setup package first
steps.instruction: Use the complete official v0.1.3 Windows x64 setup package in a separate writable folder. Its root executable is a setup host, not the completed player. Deliberately finish upstream Generate & Build with your own matching originals and its required tools before adding the player. The existing Linux setup download remains separate: use the complete Linux package and this version’s prerequisites, including CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and a C/C++ compiler where required; bundled Windows tools do not supply Linux tools. The Windows completed-player steps here do not qualify a Linux player. The standalone flow is supported; RetComM is an optional upstream manager. Portcove does not start a compiler, helper or installer while discovering a launch target.

steps.title: Keep both USA discs and your BIOS
steps.instruction: Use your own complete canonical USA disc pair, SLUS-01156 and SLUS-01179, keeping each CUE with every referenced track, and your own legal SCPH-1001 BIOS. OpenBIOS is not qualified for this title. The published first-track identity is not a complete two-disc verification. Upstream reports one corrected Windows Disc 2 operator test; that does not establish every transition, save/reload or future rebuilt version.

steps.title: Add the completed native player
steps.instruction: Select build-release/Valkyrie_Profile_Recompiled.exe, or the actual completed product in your upstream-configured build directory. Use its containing directory as the normal working folder, preserving a different established working directory if your actual working launch requires it. A normally prepared product needs no extra arguments; retain any actual supported --game plus absolute configuration path, disc, BIOS or memory-card arguments used by your working copy as separate literal arguments. Do not select the root setup host, which can forward to another executable and exit. Save launch details, then choose Play separately.

steps.title: Preserve the complete creating project and profiles
steps.instruction: Keep the whole setup project, both original discs, BIOS, generated sources, build-release or custom build directory, dependencies, game.toml, game_options.toml, settings.toml, sidecar .cfg files, cards, saves, states, mods, caches, logs and unknown files. Runtime paths anchor to the actual executable, with some source paths searched above it; inspect the actual settings and preserve custom paths and both root/build histories. You or upstream manage rebuilds and updates. Portcove registration provides no managed backup, update, rollback or migration; removing registration leaves every external file untouched.

warnings: Project-owned GPL terms do not grant rights to original game data, generated retail code, BIOS or separately licensed dependencies. Keep private prepared outputs private unless their applicable terms permit sharing.
